spotify_pw = [x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='spotify'][0]
login_resp = apis.spotify.login(username='tr_solo@gmail.com', password=spotify_pw)
access_token = login_resp['access_token']

# Gather unique artists from all liked songs
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
unique_artists = {}  # id -> name
while True:
    liked = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by='-liked_at')
    print('liked_page', page_index, 'count', len(liked))
    if not liked:
        break
    for s in liked:
        for a in s.get('artists', []):
            unique_artists[a['id']] = a['name']
    page_index += 1

artist_ids = sorted(unique_artists.keys())
print('unique_artist_count', len(artist_ids))
print('artist_ids', artist_ids)

# Check following status and follow missing ones
not_following = []
for artist_id in artist_ids:
    status_resp = apis.spotify.show_artist_following(artist_id=artist_id, access_token=access_token)
    following = status_resp.get('following', False) if isinstance(status_resp, dict) else False
    name = unique_artists.get(artist_id)
    print('artist', artist_id, name, 'following?', following)
    if not following:
        not_following.append(artist_id)

print('not_following_count', len(not_following))

followed = []
for artist_id in not_following:
    r = apis.spotify.follow_artist(artist_id=artist_id, access_token=access_token)
    followed.append(artist_id)
    print('followed', artist_id, unique_artists.get(artist_id), 'resp', r)

print('followed_count', len(followed))

spotify_pw = [x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='spotify'][0]
login_resp = apis.spotify.login(username='tr_solo@gmail.com', password=spotify_pw)
access_token = login_resp['access_token']

# verify all unique artists are now following
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
unique_artists = {} 
while True:
    liked = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by='-liked_at')
    if not liked:
        break
    for s in liked:
        for a in s.get('artists', []):
            unique_artists[a['id']] = a['name']
    page_index += 1
artist_ids = list(unique_artists.keys())

not_following_after = []
for artist_id in artist_ids:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_artist_following(artist_id=artist_id, access_token=access_token)
    following = resp.get('following', False) if isinstance(resp, dict) else False
    if not following:
        not_following_after.append(artist_id)

print('unique_artist_count', len(artist_ids))
print('not_following_after_count', len(not_following_after))
print('not_following_after', not_following_after)
